A displacement in metres, not a gait speed and not a clinical walking distance. | Cadence (steps s⁻¹) (steps s⁻¹): the number of advancing left-right support transitions divided by the rollout duration. A transition advances when the incoming support foot lands at least 0.01 m in front of the outgoing one, so only forward steps are counted. | Step length (m) (m): the net forward hip displacement of the rollout divided by its number of advancing steps, that is, the mean forward progression per advancing step. A rollout with no advancing step has no step length and is dropped. Negative values indicate net backward progression. | Advancing-step count imbalance (dimensionless): the absolute difference between the numbers of left and right advancing steps divided by their sum: 0 for perfectly alternating left-right stepping, 1 when every advancing step falls on the same side.
